path_step: Teacher deletes an existing file group
test_scenario: Verify that a teacher can successfully delete an existing file group after confirmation.
pre_condition: Teacher is logged in, has access to a course with at least one existing file group (with or without files), and is on the 'Files' tab of the Course Details page.
expected_result: The file group is removed from the file structure, and the system displays the updated file structure.
post_condition: The file group is deleted from the system.

test_steps.step: Navigate to the 'Files' tab on the Course Details page.
Click the 'Delete' button next to an existing file group.
System prompts the Teacher for confirmation.
System displays the updated file structure.
